raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / GREENCARPET | APPARTAMENTI ESCLUSIVI - FRONTE MARE - LIDO DI JESOLO NEW DEVELOPMENT · APARTMENT GreenCarpet | Appartamenti Esclusivi - Fronte Mare - Lido di Jesolo PINETA · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE Price on request Photos (38) Floor plans (0) 1 / 38 BEDROOMS 3 BATHROOMS 2 LIFT Yes ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview GreenCarpet is a seafront residential project that will be developed in the Pineta of Jesolo, but it is primarily the desire to introduce a recognizable, desirable product into the market that can sustain its value over time. Its architectural configuration prioritizes exclusive and independent living units, as they are located one per floor, self-sufficient from an infrastructural point of view, with high privacy and a direct relationship with the surrounding environment. The project stands out for its spacious fully glazed loggias and the ground floor structure designed to promote visual continuity and ideal interaction with nature. To bring this distinctive project to life, we have involved a team of Italian excellence — representing the best talent in the area — capable of transforming interior design, outdoor spaces, landscape, light, and choice of finishes into a single harmonious vision of beauty. Our Partners: Villevenete: for setting up outdoor areas and possible interior design solutions. Decoratori Bassanesi: for wall coverings and wooden/granite flooring. iGuzzini: for lighting design projects. VeniceGreen: for landscaping projects including gardens and terraces. Direct Commercial Partner: This operation is managed in commercial partnership with JBC Immobiliare. The sale is direct and not subject to commission or real estate mediation. Features and Amenities: Spacious areas flooded with natural light open onto scenic panoramic terraces: true open-air lounges designed to contemplate the horizon, welcome guests or indulge in luxury dining at sunset while lulled by the sound of waves. The residential experience further elevates thanks to a collection of wellness spaces exclusively available where breathtaking sea views frame every moment throughout the day. From rejuvenating paths in private SPA facilities to relaxation on poolside solariums; from energizing workouts in high-end panoramic gyms—every detail has been crafted to offer an uncompromising lifestyle suspended between elegance and nature. Location: Jesolo Pineta – Seafront Contact us immediately for information, floor plans & booking your preview visit on site.
